idealneoad.description: IDEAL NEO ADSlim and symmetrical profiles refer to current design trends and give lightness and elegance to the windows. Extremely narrow profile combinations mean even more light in the rooms. An attractive solution for both new built and renovation.B class profile..

idealneomdfs.name: IDEAL NEO MD FS
idealneomdfs.description: IDEAL NEO MD-FSis an extremely attractive design proposition for customers who value timeless style. A simple, symmetrical, cubist shape is the distinguishing feature of the system. Sharpes angles and geometric architecture, and at the same time visual lightness of the structure.

idealneomdmonoblock.name: IDEAL NEO MD MONOBLOCK
idealneomdmonoblock.description: IDEAL NEO MD MONOBLOCKMonoblock frames are designed for the construction of windows, which are installed in a layer of insulation. The wide range of Monoblock frames (76 mm, 122 mm, 142 mm, 162 mm) allows their appropriate selection depending on the thickness of the insulation. A special shelf (window sill) located from the outer side of the frame in an aesthetic manner masks the insulation around the perimeter of the window avoiding the formation of thermal bridges. The inner rebate of the Monoblock frame ensures aesthetic installation from the inside of the room without the need of gypsum treatment.76 mm122 mm142 mm162 mm

idealneomdrenovation.name: IDEAL NEO MD RENOVATION
idealneomdrenovation.description: IDEAL NEO MD RENOVATIONThe renovation frame system is used for window installation without the need to dismantle old frames. The specificity of this type of windows is based on the use of special renovation frames with a so-called masking profile, which encompasses the wooden frame, creating a characteristic band from the inside, and on the outside we can use special housing profiles. The masking profiles in the framework have different widths (40 mm, 70 mm), but it is also possible to cut them for specific needs.40 mm (A)40 mm (B)70 mm

ideal7000nl.name: IDEAL 7000 NL
ideal7000nl.description: IDEAL 7000 NLis the perfect solution for the Dutch market. Thanks to its 120 mm wide frame with external rebates, IDEAL 7000 NL provides an easy, fast and aesthetically pleasing way to install windows in a building made of facing brick (clinker) without additional masonry work.
